formal_scope: Three actual arbitrary-group subgroup theorems for an arbitrary homomorphism f and subgroups P<=Q: equal-image cancellation, saturation/intersection criterion, and equivalent equality of restriction kernels. No finiteness.
formal_application_bridge: In the permutation argument, restrict the homomorphism to the setwise stabilizer of X; replace Q by its intersection with that stabilizer. The saturation itself preserves X. Its kernel intersection is exactly Q intersect Sym(X). This bridge, supported-factor generation, and the string end induction remain written.
